title: Many Notifications Scroll
description: Generate enough activity to overflow the notification dropdown's fixed-height list and prove the oldest entries are still reachable by scrolling, not silently clipped off or dropped from the DOM.
successCondition: After generating at least 10 notifying events for one user (e.g. booking and paying for several shipments), the dropdown's notification list renders inside a scrollable container (max-h-80 overflow-y-auto), all 10+ items are present in the DOM (not virtualized away), and a test scrolling that specific container to its bottom can locate and interact with (e.g. click "Mark read" on) the oldest notification in the list.
hints: Booking a shipment and paying its invoice each produce one notification — repeat that pair a handful of times across different shipments to build up volume quickly.
Scroll the notification list's own container element, not the page — the dropdown panel itself doesn't grow past its max height.
